# Motion Dojo

> Motion Dojo is a community for smartphone motion designers and the home of Black Belt in Motion Design, a course that teaches you to create professional animations on your phone.

Website: https://joinmotiondojo.com
Members' platform: https://connect.joinmotiondojo.com (Motion Dojo Connect)
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/joinmotiondojo
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@joinmotiondojo

## What Motion Dojo is
- A community for smartphone motion designers and creative enthusiasts who want to learn and grow together.
- Built around three things: learning, community and growth.
- Members share their work, get feedback and connect on Motion Dojo Connect, the community's own platform.
- Slogan: "Train like a ninja, create like a master."

## Black Belt in Motion Design (the course)
- Motion Dojo's complete course for creating professional animations with Alight Motion on a smartphone, from beginner to pro.
- Four phases, named after belts: White Belt (Foundations), Yellow Belt (Alight Motion mastery), Green Belt (Creative execution), Black Belt (Portfolio and mastery).
- Price: ₦40,000 one-time, or two payments of ₦20,000.
- Page: https://joinmotiondojo.com/blackbelt

## Who it is for
- Motion design enthusiasts with a smartphone
- Beginners who have watched tutorials but can't yet create industry-standard videos
- Business owners who want to animate for their own brand
- Graphic designers adding motion to their skills

## Pages
- [Home](https://joinmotiondojo.com/): what Motion Dojo is, who it is for, the team
- [Black Belt in Motion Design](https://joinmotiondojo.com/blackbelt): curriculum, projects, pricing, FAQ
